                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/Javaer1995/p/18539380" title="发布于 2025-10-12 20:25">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">硬盘状态信息的查看与坏道检测</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="1下载diskgenius工具">1、下载DiskGenius工具</h2>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2052479/202411/2052479-20241111114012317-1833700174.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>官网下载地址：<a href="https://www.diskgenius.cn/download.php" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://www.diskgenius.cn/download.php</a></p>
<h2 id="2解压diskgenius工具包">2、解压DiskGenius工具包</h2>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2052479/202411/2052479-20241111114556704-512459284.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="3启动diskgenius工具">3、启动DiskGenius工具</h2>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2052479/202411/2052479-20241111114703032-38207623.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="4同意许可协议">4、同意许可协议</h2>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2052479/202411/2052479-20241111114807920-503206222.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="5查看硬盘状态信息">5、查看硬盘状态信息</h2>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2052479/202411/2052479-20241111114915090-521278603.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2052479/202411/2052479-20241111115418732-451592912.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>如上图所示，选择要查看的硬盘（一般只有一个硬盘），便可看到该硬盘此刻的工作温度、通电时间、通电次数。</p>
<blockquote>
<p>注意：新硬盘的通电时间和次数，一般都很少（出厂前有检测，所以不会完全没有通电）；如果通电时间和次数太多，基本就是旧硬盘。</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="6硬盘坏道检测">6、硬盘坏道检测</h2>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2052479/202411/2052479-20241111115935661-2043171891.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2052479/202411/2052479-20241111123401676-467031878.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>如上图所示，选择要检测的硬盘和范围，然后开始检测。</p>
<blockquote>
<p>提示：只有机械硬盘才有可能存在坏道，所以固态硬盘无需进行坏道检测。</p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2052479/202411/2052479-20241111143727528-243579981.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>如上图所示，本例检测没有发现坏道；如果发现有坏道，可以点击“尝试修复”按钮来修复坏道。</p>

</div>
